sections.paragraph: Six days of higher-dose ivermectin did not improve sustained recovery from acute COVID-19. Ovarian, brain, breast and colorectal cancer experiments reported effects in cells or animals, without a patient benefit estimate from those experiments. The liver-cancer combination report is retracted and excluded from efficacy conclusions. The ovarian experiment measured PAK1 inhibition and reduced growth in cultured cells, rather than survival or symptoms in patients. The glioblastoma work investigated mitochondrial stress and tumor growth in preclinical models, while the breast-cancer work linked PAK1/Akt signaling to growth-arresting autophagy. The colorectal study investigated WNT-TCF signaling in laboratory and tumor models. These experiments address separate biological processes and cannot be combined into a patient response rate or a demonstrated survival benefit across cancers.
